ImpactAlpha2026-09-29

EU greenwashing rules take effect: net-zero claims need verified plans, offset-based 'carbon neutral' labels banned

The EU's EmpCo Directive now applies: net-zero pledges need measurable, time-bound plans with independent verification, and offset-reliant products can no longer be labelled 'carbon neutral'. Banks are covered too, though at least 17 member states had not transposed it as of June.
